'''Liuqin''' is a researcher of medicines working at [[Huaxu Academy]] in {{Location|Jinzhou}}. He is the brother of [[Koko]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First time meeting)<!---not sure if missing dialogue options, can't find this prompt anymore--->
:'''Liuqin:''' Should I join Mr. [[Mortefi]]'s project? ...Koko, would you support my decision?
:'''Liuqin:''' Ah, you must be the Rover. What can I do for you?
:'''{{DIcon}}:''' Mortefi's project?
:'''Liuqin:''' Koko is my little sister, and she's currently the acting manager of [[Shifang Pharmacy]].
:'''Liuqin:''' Yesterday, Mr. Mortefi invited me to join one of his projects.
:'''Liuqin:''' But joining would mean spending even less time with Koko.
:'''{{DIcon}}:''' Why is this project so appealing to you?
:'''Liuqin:''' I don't want to pass up this chance. It's more than just a project. Being able to working{{sic}} alongside Mr. Mortefi is an honor itself.
:'''Liuqin:''' He's probably the most respected researcher here, just behind our Principal Investigator, Mr. [[Xiangli Yao]].
:'''Liuqin:''' He's great at fending off unreasonable client demands. He rejected over 40 of them in his first week alone!
:'''Liuqin:''' He even treats us to afternoon tea. He really looks out for us.
:'''{{DIcon}}:''' Who's more talented than this Mortefi? 
:'''Liuqin:''' Mortefi's been trying to outdo him in research, but it's not easy. Xiangli is just... built different.
:'''Liuqin:''' About Mr. Xiangli... You'll see what I mean when you meet him.
----
;(Outdoor 6PM-12AM)
:'''Liuqin:''' Hmm... the medicine seems to be working better this time.
:{{DIcon}}: Is he sick?
:'''Liuqin:''' Yes, this is my patient, [[Niu]]. He's got a strange illness, and the usual meds don't work on him.
:'''Liuqin:''' So I decided to try a new medicine, hoping it'll do the trick.
----
;(Indoor 1AM-9AM)
:'''Liuqin:''' Rover, is that you? You're still up at this hour?
:'''Liuqin:''' You gotta get more sleep, or you'll end up like us, unable to sleep even when you want to.
:'''{{DIcon}}:''' Have you been busy lately?
:'''Liuqin:''' We're pretty much always busy.
:'''Liuqin:''' You know what? Koko might actually be right. I've seriously considered quitting my job to join her, running the pharmacy.
:'''Liuqin:''' But after mulling it over, I still preferred to stay and do research.
:'''Liuqin:''' Our current medicines can handle most diseases.
:'''Liuqin:''' However, with the discovery of more diseases and the spread of new treatments, we're also facing an increasing number of pathogens.
:'''Liuqin:''' So, meds gotta stay up to date, and my job is to give more powerful tools to those battling diseases.
{{Dialogue End}}
